_comment: The org project board (design 6.6). apply-board.py creates the board, its fields, linked repos and views; verify-settings.py checks them. Owner is the built-in Assignees field; Type is the issue type, usable in filters but not as a column through the API. The API can set a view's name, layout, filter and columns but not its grouping, sorting or board column field: apply-board.py lists those as steps to do by hand, and verify-settings.py checks them. Single-select option names match the issue form answers exactly.
title: Akenon Studio
description: All work across the org: one board, every repo. Fields come from the issue forms.

reasons._comment: The Reason rules that are not just a label or a Status (scripts/reason.py). report_authors: bots whose open issues are reports for a person (Report; they start in Waiting for human). exempt_labels: a bot's issue or PR with one of these needs no Reason (Peras renders plan sub-issues that wait on no one until Peras says so, design 7.13). new_bug: the label a bug report carries until it is triaged. Any other open bot issue, or bot PR that closes no issue, with no Reason is flagged needs-fields, so new bot output cannot miss Needs a human.

options.name: Waiting for human
options.description: Paused until a person answers or reviews

options.name: Blocked
options.description: Cannot move until something else is done

fields.name: Reason
fields._comment: Why an open item waits on a person (design 6.6), set and cleared only by the automation (scripts/reason.py), never by hand. An item has the first that applies, in this order; the option descriptions say when each applies. Rules beyond the options are under 'reasons'.

options.name: Needs fields
options.description: Labelled needs-fields: its comment says what to fix

options.name: Review
options.description: In review, or a bot's PR with no issue behind it

options.name: Report
options.description: An issue the automation opened for a person

options.name: New bug
options.description: A bug report not yet triaged

options.name: Waiting on
options.description: Anything else in Waiting for human

fields.name: Epic
fields._comment: One option per epic, kept by issue_fields.py from each issue's parents, never set by hand (design 6.6): the option's name is the epic's title, its description the epic's repo#n. apply-board.py creates the field with the epics that exist; verify-settings.py checks only that it exists.

fields.name: Iteration
fields._comment: Weekly, Saturday to Friday: the Friday planning meeting closes one week and commits the next.

fields.name: Audit
fields._comment: Audit findings only, phase 1. Options match the Audit finding form.

fields.name: Peras
fields._comment: Cycle state and link, intents only. Set by Peras, never by hand.

views.name: Needs a human
views._comment: Everything waiting on a person, grouped by why (design 6.6): issues flagged needs-fields, issues In review and bot PRs, the automation's reports, untriaged bugs, and anything else in Waiting for human. The Reason field does the work, since a filter cannot OR across fields and a view cannot group by label.

views.name: My work
views._comment: What I and my agents (who work as my login) are on, flagged issues included: their needs-fields label shows.

views.name: Epics
views._comment: Each open epic and how much of it is done and left (design 6.6).

views.name: Overview
views._note: Sliced by Discipline (the side list with a count per discipline), set by hand: the API can neither set nor read a view slice, so this is not checked.
